description: Student org wants 20 hoodies, size M, asking for a bulk discount.
outcome: The price-override inquiry was resolved by a documented Boss decision not to offer the infeasible 20-unit quantity or an unapproved bulk discount. Inventory verified 8 in stock and 12 missing with no supplier; Accounting verified $58 list price and $22 unit cost. Customer Service prepared a final unsent draft disclosing that decision. No offer, purchase, fulfillment, payment, or customer contact occurred.

agents.name: boss
agents.contribution: Coordinated Inventory, Accounting, and Customer Service and made a final no-offer internal decision based on verified constraints.

agents.name: inventory
agents.contribution: Verified eight in stock, a 12-unit shortage, and no matching vendor or lead time.

agents.name: accounting
agents.contribution: Verified $58.00 list price, $22.00 unit cost, derived $36.00 gross margin per unit, $160.00 cash, and no defensible specific discount.

agents.name: customer_service
agents.contribution: Prepared a final unsent draft stating eight available, the full 20 unavailable, and no bulk discount offered now; no delivery promise.
